Raghu Dixit addresses criticism over age gap with wife

Singer Raghu Dixit has spoken about criticism he faced regarding the 16-year age gap between himself and his wife, Varijashree Venugopal. Dixit stated that the criticism did hurt him, but he never felt the need to explain the situation. The comments address public scrutiny over their relationship.
